title: LCSHBench: A Multilingual, Consensus-Grounded Benchmark for Library of Congress Subject Heading Assignment
abstract: arXiv:2606.04382v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automated subject cataloging assigns controlledvocabulary headings to bibliographic records, but LCSH has no standard public benchmark. We introduce LCSHBench: 22,346 books in 15 languages from the openly licensed Harvard, Columbia, and Princeton catalogs. Records enter only when at least two independent cataloging agencies assigned LCSH; we release per-catalog provenance plus union and unanimous answer views. A concordance study of 465,187 works cataloged by all three libraries shows why this design matters: libraries usually agree on the underlying topic (93.3% share a concept-level heading) but often differ in exact expression (39.4% have identical heading sets). LCSHBench therefore scores both exact and concept matches, with set and rank metrics broken down by language and heading type, across open-vocabulary generation and full-vocabulary retrieval. As a first demonstration, a low-rank fine-tune of a 300M on-device embedde

translated_title: LCSHBench：一个多语言、基于共识的美国国会图书馆主题标目（LCSH）分配基准
translated_abstract: 自动主题编目是将受控词表标目分配给书目记录的过程，但LCSH（美国国会图书馆主题词表）一直缺乏标准的公开基准。我们推出LCSHBench：该数据集包含来自哈佛大学、哥伦比亚大学和普林斯顿大学开放许可目录的15种语言共22,346本图书。只有当至少两个独立编目机构为记录分配了LCSH标目时，该记录才被纳入数据集；我们同时发布了逐馆来源信息以及并集和完全一致两种答案视图。针对三家图书馆共同编目的465,187部作品开展的一致性研究证明了这一设计的必要性：各图书馆通常在底层主题上达成一致（93.3%的记录共享概念级标目），但在确切表达上往往不同（仅39.4%的记录具有完全相同的标目集合）。因此，LCSHBench同时评估精确匹配与概念匹配，并按语言和标目类型细分集合与排序指标，涵盖开放词表生成和全词表检索两类任务。作为首次演示，对一个3亿参数的端侧嵌入模型进行低秩微调……
tldr: LCSHBench是首个基于多家图书馆编目共识构建的多语言公开基准，涵盖15种语言2万余本书，用于评估LCSH主题标目的自动分配，并同时衡量精确匹配与概念级匹配两种结果。
en_tdlr: LCSHBench is the first public, consensus-grounded multilingual benchmark (22,346 books in 15 languages) for automatic LCSH subject heading assignment, evaluating both exact and concept-level matches.
